feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Tropical Storm Rachel downgraded as high winds and rain turn inward
entry.summary: Forecasters say the storm, which brought heavy rain and coastal flooding, is a preview of what may be in store as California braces for a possibly record-setting El Niño.

entry.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week
entry.summary: Pope Leo XIV said he would undergo surgery after doctors found a "localized nodule" in his lung.

entry.title: Hurricane Simon nears Mexico with 155 mph winds and flooding fears
entry.summary: The eye of Hurricane Simon was just off the Pacific coast of Mexico early Sunday and was expected to move inland later in the day as an extremely powerful storm.

entry.title: Justice Department investigates TV networks, citing possible anti-trust violations
entry.summary: The move escalates Trump's fight with the press amid court battle over barring CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House.

entry.title: Don't be scared: Being afraid is outright fun, and maybe useful
entry.summary: Listeners of NPR's Weekend Edition Sunday may already know that host Ayesha Rascoe loves horror. But why do scream queens (and kings) like her like what's frightening? The answer may surprise you.

entry.title: She was a global star: Teen bikes 700 miles carrying injured dad. Where is she now?
entry.summary: Her epic ride — carrying her injured dad on her $20 hot pink bicycle — made headlines. Promises were made — financial help, training for a cycling career, even a movie deal. Were any of them kept?

entry.title: Sweating the details: Sauna's potential health benefits draw scientists' interest
entry.summary: A group of international researchers is pushing to rigorously study the potential health benefits of sauna and other heat therapies. They hope to bring scientific legitimacy to the age-old practices.

entry.title: It's taking longer to find a new job after losing one
entry.summary: People who lose their jobs in this economy are taking longer to find new work. Nearly four in ten people exhaust their unemployment benefits before they land a new job.

entry.title: In one of the country's most competitive districts, a Democrat tries to keep her seat
entry.summary: In a highly competitive Washington congressional race, the incumbent Democrat has angered part of her party base and the Trump-backed Republican challenger faces backlash against the party in power.

entry.title: Reshaped civil rights mission at Justice Department transforms its work, workforce
entry.summary: Harmeet Dhillon has pushed out hundreds of longtime attorneys, replaced many with inexperienced ideological allies, and used the division's enforcement powers to pursue the president's agenda.
